lines.en: - Joey, where's the pipe that was holding the door open?
- I don't know.
- Yeah, I do.
- Monica!
- Come on!
- I can't believe this!
- All right, well, you know,
I guess we know what we have to do to get down.
- Yeah, I guess we don't have a choice.
- Help us!
Please help us!
We're stuck up on the roof and we can't get down!
- Ross.
I was thinking we'd just go down the fire escape.
- I know, I wasn't finished.
But don't worry!
- We're going to go down the fire escape!
- All right, I won't go down any further.
It's stuck.
- Well, we're just going to have to jump.
Yeah.
Now, we're going to have to make sure to land to the right
of that patch of ice, okay?
Not hit the dumpster on the other side
and try to avoid that weird, brownish-red stuff in the middle.
So, when you get down there,
you go up to the roof and you let me in.
Whoa, wait a minute.
I have to do it?
- Yeah, oh yeah, you'll be fine.
It'll be just like bungee jumping, you know?
But instead of bouncing back up, you, you won't.
- Well, what if I smack my head on the concrete?
- Well, I'm not going to lie to you, Joey.
It's a possibility.
- I don't know, Ross.
I'll tell you what.
Let's flip to see who does it, okay?
- Yeah, you call it in the air, all right?
- All right.
Can you see what it is?
- No.
- Okay, well, you be careful.
- No, no, Ross, no, no, stop.
I'm not jumping.
- Okay, look, I have an audition tomorrow
and I can't go if I break my leg.
- Well, I'm not jumping.
I have a son, okay?
He won't have a father if I die.
- Well, all right, so it looks like we're even.
- Okay, you have a good grip?
- Yeah.
- Okay, I'm going to start to climb down you now.
- All right, just hurry up.
- Okay.
Now, now, now, should I climb down your front
so we're face to face
or should I climb down your back
so we're, we're butt to face?
- Face to face, face to face, yeah.
- Okay, here I come.
- Oh, my, how much do you weigh, Ross?
- I prefer not to answer that right now.
I'm still carrying a little holiday weight.
- You know, when we talked about face to face,
I don't think we thought it all the way through.
- What do you want me to do?
- Just shimmy down me and drop.
- All right.
- Maybe I should hang and you should climb down me.
- Maybe we should talk about that for a little while.
- It still looks pretty far.
- It's not that far, just drop.
- Now, rush me!
- Ross, you should know that my pants
are starting to come down
and I'm not wearing any underwear.
- Ow!
My ankle, I really hurt my ankle.
I think I twisted it.
Ooh, a quarter.
